sections.name: Tata Nexon EV
lines: The Tata Nexon E V launched in 2020, and became one of India's best selling electric cars.
Today it comes with different battery sizes, up to forty five kilowatt hours.
The biggest battery has a claimed range of up to four hundred and eighty nine kilometres. Real world is lower.
The long range motor makes a hundred and forty five P S, and two hundred and fifteen newton metres from zero r p m.
Vehicle to load lets you run appliances from the car, and even charge another E V.
It scored five stars in the Bharat N CAP crash test.
Charge it overnight at home, or use a D C fast charger on longer trips.
The car that made electric mainstream in India.
